title: Opening or Buying? A Probabilistic and Risk-Adjusted Comparison of Pokémon TCG Booster Acquisition and Secondary-Market Purchases
description:
Working paper and replication package. The repository contains the code, configurations, pull-rate snapshot, derived results and the paper (research/paper/paper.pdf).

Three English sets (Stellar Crown, Surging Sparks, Destined Rivals) are modelled slot by slot, with Dirichlet posteriors on community pull rates propagated through a nested Monte Carlo (200 posterior draws × 20,000 runs). Cards are valued at TCGplayer market prices in USD on 2026-11-15 under three pre-registered cost scenarios. Under the central scenario, the break-even booster price is 1.03 to 1.42 USD against a retail price of 4.49 USD, and buying single cards is decisively better than opening in 35 of 36 budget comparisons. Opening loses on average in all sixteen pre-registered robustness variants.

Interactive demo: https://azekf11.github.io/PokeQuant/
